name: Stock trading
description: Long/short 30 US mega-caps on daily bars (2016–2026). Naive 6-month momentum, weekly rebalance. Score is net Sharpe after 5 bp costs and borrow on a 2019–2026 walk-forward. Patches stack on the parent and are scored by a real backtest, not a canned lift.

patches.title: Volatility targeting
patches.summary: Scale the whole book to a 10% annualized vol target using trailing 21-day book variance.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/task_agent.py
+++ b/domains/markets/task_agent.py
@@ -22,6 +22,14 @@
-    weights = sign(signal) * 1.0 / n_names
+    raw = sign(signal)
+    vol = realized_vol(returns, window=21).clip(0.08, 0.80)
+    target = 0.10
+    weights = raw * (target / vol)
+    weights = weights / weights.abs().sum().clip(lower=1e-8)

patches.title: Cost hurdle
patches.summary: Skip a name unless |signal| clears an 8% lookback move, so tiny edges do not pay the spread.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/costs.py
+++ b/domains/markets/costs.py
@@ -8,2 +8,11 @@
+def hurdle_bps(spread, adv, notional):
+    slip = 4.0 + 6.0 * (notional / adv).clip(0, 1)
+    return spread * 1e4 + 0.5 + slip
+
+def take(signal, cost_bps):
+    edge = expected_edge_bps(signal)
+    return signal.where(edge > cost_bps, 0.0)

patches.title: Regime filter
patches.summary: Flat the book when 20-day realized vol of SPY is in the top quintile or breadth is collapsing.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/task_agent.py
+++ b/domains/markets/task_agent.py
@@ -41,3 +41,12 @@
+    spy_vol = realized_vol(spy, 20)
+    chop = spy_vol > spy_vol.rolling(252).quantile(0.80)
+    breadth = (signal > 0).mean(axis=1)
+    risk_off = chop | (breadth < 0.15) | (breadth > 0.85)
+    weights = weights.mask(risk_off, 0.0)

patches.title: Drawdown breaker
patches.summary: Cut gross exposure in half after a 6% peak-to-trough, and go flat after 10% until a new equity high.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/risk.py
+++ b/domains/markets/risk.py
@@ -14,1 +14,12 @@
+def scale_for_drawdown(equity, weights):
+    peak = equity.cummax()
+    dd = (equity / peak) - 1.0
+    scale = np.where(dd < -0.10, 0.0, np.where(dd < -0.06, 0.5, 1.0))
+    return weights * scale[:, None]

patches.title: Cross-sectional rank
patches.summary: Trade the top and bottom quintiles of 12-1 momentum after neutralizing sector and beta.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/features.py
+++ b/domains/markets/features.py
@@ -19,2 +19,13 @@
-    signal = close.pct_change(21)
+    mom = close.pct_change(252) - close.pct_change(21)
+    resid = neutralize(mom, [sector_dummies, beta])
+    ranks = resid.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
+    signal = 0.0
+    signal = signal.mask(ranks >= 0.80, 1.0)
+    signal = signal.mask(ranks <= 0.20, -1.0)

patches.title: Walk-forward fit
patches.summary: Each month, estimate trailing 3-year factor IC. Go flat when the IC is dead. Never train on the evaluation month.
patches.diff:
--- a/domains/markets/task_agent.py
+++ b/domains/markets/task_agent.py
@@ -70,2 +70,10 @@
+    def fit_month(t):
+        train = panel.loc[t - pd.DateOffset(years=3): t - pd.DateOffset(days=1)]
+        return ridge.fit(train.X, train.y).coef_
+    coefs = {t: fit_month(t) for t in eval_months}
+    signal = apply_coefs(panel, coefs)

name: Paper review
description: Score scientific papers against human reviewer outcomes. Default HyperAgents setup domain.

patches.title: Structured rubric
patches.summary: Replace free-form scoring with novelty, soundness, clarity, and significance axes.
patches.diff:
--- a/task_agent.py
+++ b/task_agent.py
@@ -18,6 +18,14 @@
-    return llm.grade(paper_text)
+    axes = ["novelty", "soundness", "clarity", "significance"]
+    scores = {a: llm.grade_axis(paper_text, a) for a in axes}
+    return weighted_mean(scores)

patches.title: Citation grounding
patches.summary: Require claims to quote the paper before assigning a verdict.
patches.diff:
--- a/task_agent.py
+++ b/task_agent.py
@@ -40,4 +40,9 @@
+    quotes = extract_passages(paper_text, claim)
+    if not quotes:
+        return abstain()

patches.title: Calibration on train split
patches.summary: Fit a temperature on the filtered-100 train subset before val scoring.
patches.diff:
--- a/ensemble.py
+++ b/ensemble.py
@@ -12,3 +12,8 @@
+    T = fit_temperature(train_logits, train_labels)
+    return softmax(logits / T)

patches.title: Reject-mode hedge
patches.summary: When reviewers disagree, emit a low-confidence class instead of a hard accept.
patches.diff:
--- a/task_agent.py
+++ b/task_agent.py
@@ -61,2 +61,7 @@
+    if entropy(dist) > 1.2:
+        return "borderline"
